chemical: Silver tip-Green tip stage: Mancozeb (400 g) or Captan (300 g) per 100 litres water
Pink bud stage: Contaf (30 ml) or Baycor (50 g) per 100 litres water
Petal fall stage: Bavistin (50 g) or Topsin M (50 g) per 100 litres water
Pea stage: Mancozeb (300 g) or Captan (300 g) per 100 litres water
Fruit development stage: Bavistin + Mancozeb (25 + 250 g) per 100 litres water
15-20 days before harvest: Mancozeb (300 g) per 100 litres water
Before leaf fall: Urea (5 kg) per 100 litres water

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.source_note: No source found. This rust needs juniper/cedar hosts and is mainly reported in North America; the Indian sources checked do not cover it.

Collect the remains of the crop and destroy by burning or burying

chemical: Spray Mancozeb or Zineb @ 2-4 g/litre, or Propiconazole 25% EC @ 1 ml/litre, at 35 and 50 days after sowing (DAS)

Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.source_note: No source found. The NHB grape page covers Alternaria leaf blight, which is a different pathogen; do not use it for Isariopsis leaf spot.

Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).source_note: TNAU page has no management text. ICAR sources describe the disease as spread by the citrus psylla and infected budwood, with no cure. Treatment advice still needed.

organic_cultural: Field sanitation is important
Obtain seed from disease-free plants

Do not spray streptomycin after fruits begin to form
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.source_note: TNAU Agritech Portal, Chilli bacterial leaf spot (Xanthomonas campestris pv. vesicatoria), updated Jun 2023. The page also lists a mercuric chloride seed treatment; it is left out here because mercury compounds are highly toxic.

organic_cultural: Use disease-free seed tubers for planting
Remove and destroy infected plant debris (soil spores are the primary infection source)
Variety Kufri Sindhuri has fair resistance
chemical: Very early spray with Zineb or Captan at 0.2%, repeated every 15-20 days
Potato___Early_blight.source_note: TNAU Agritech Portal, potato disease page.

Potato___Late_blight.status: SOURCED - ICAR research paper (field trial result, not an official label dose)
organic_cultural: Resistant varieties in trials: Kufri Girdhari, then Kufri Himalini
Planting date affects disease: last week of April for the susceptible variety, mid-May to first week of June for resistant varieties (Nilgiris trial)
chemical: Best schedule 1: Mancozeb @ 0.2% as prophylactic first spray, then Azoxystrobin @ 0.1% as second spray
Best schedule 2: Mancozeb @ 0.2% as prophylactic first spray, then Dimethomorph + Mancozeb @ 0.3% as second spray
Continue the same sequence depending on weather, up to 75 days, at 7-10 day intervals
Potato___Late_blight.source_note: Potato Journal (ICAR), 'Management of potato late blight (Phytophthora infestans) in the Nilgiris', Vol 46(1), 2019. Checked against the abstract on the ICAR page. Nilgiris trial conditions; follow label and local agriculture officer's advice.
